title: ch06_assessment
description: Logical Chapter Eight measurement snapshot; semantic meaning and obligations are in core_08_standing_assessment.md and core_09_standing_integration.md. Snapshots that drive standing effect must reflect verified standing inputs only (demonstrable Contribution Axis; verified violation findings for the Violation Axis per Chapter Eight Verified inputs for standing and Chapter Five Violation Nature); allegations and forum-phase material are not standing inputs. Chapter Nine recency/currentness is a Question 3 gate/readiness input only and must not alter this snapshot's Contribution Axis slot or LEQU measurement. Chapter Nine decides violation locks before contribution gates. Cross-field and decision-order rules may require validators beyond this schema or custom assertions.

assessment_id.description: Stable identifier for this assessment snapshot (UUID recommended).

subject_ref.description: Who or what is classified (URI or implementation-stable key).

evaluation_scope.description: Boundaries under which inputs were evaluated (jurisdiction, system, time window).

assessed_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime when the snapshot was issued.

assessor.description: Party responsible for the classification (role, system component, or office code).

rationale_uri.description: Optional pointer to auditable reasoning artifact.

descriptors.description: Supplemental D2-* tags; order not normative.

axis_two.description: Omit or null only when the record asserts no adverse Chapter Eight violation typing for the declared scope.

legal_types.description: Subset of legal-constitutional types; empty array allowed only when legal typing is genuinely undetermined (rationale_uri should explain deferral).

highest_severity.description: When axis_two is non-null, MUST equal axis_two.severity for a coherent snapshot.

chapter_seven.description: Legacy property name for optional Chapter Ten designation data. Chapter Eight supplies the fixed impact slot; Chapter Ten may attach the corresponding anti-constitutional-misconduct designation without changing it.

slot.description: Existing Chapter Eight impact slot to which the Chapter Ten designation attaches; Chapter Ten does not assign this number.

tier.description: Legacy shorthand only: T1 maps to slot 7, T2 to slot 8, and T3 to slot 9.

reference.description: Link to tier determination packet, docket, or system record.

nine_slot.description: Optional numeric layer for the unified Chapter Eight proportional LEQU scale: nine shared 5x impact bands on each separate axis, anchored at s=7 = 1 LEQU. Conduct character, Chapter Nine recency/currentness, and Chapter Ten designation do not change the slot. Contribution also requires its constitutional-alignment conditions. No netting is permitted.

c_unit.description: Legacy field name for the LEQU display scalar; default 1 LEQU. The same 5x thresholds apply to both axes.

c_star_cumulative.description: Legacy interoperability field. Historical records may contain a recency-weighted contribution sum, but this value must not derive, raise, or lower a Chapter Eight Contribution Axis slot or LEQU measurement; Chapter Nine recency/currentness is for Question 3 gate/readiness decisions only.

contribution_slot.description: Contribution impact slot under the shared Chapter Eight LEQU bands after applicable contribution conditions are satisfied; must not be derived from Chapter Nine recency/currentness or a legacy recency-weighted c_star_cumulative value.

violation_lequ_loss.description: Integrated verified constitutional loss in LEQU after proportional scaling; conduct character is not a multiplier.

violation_slot.description: Violation impact slot assigned from violation_lequ_loss under the shared Chapter Eight bands.

highest_finding_slot.description: Deprecated alias for violation_slot retained for existing records.

v_star_sum.description: Deprecated legacy analytics only; must not derive, raise, or lower a violation impact slot.

violationSeverity.description: Neutral impact keys V-MIN through V-CAT are current. V-FN through V-CN are legacy character-based aliases and must not derive a slot in new records.
